method: Existing production meter harness plus real FluxBlizzardMeter. External pinned native ApplySystemAnchor/SetPointOverride/ClearAllPointsOverride/SetScaleOverride bodies replayed; widget methods, geometry, protected context and native manager/snap callbacks explicitly mocked. One initial Embed warm-up per plain/gamepad fixture; native late restore then500native restoration bursts. Five fresh-process AB/BA pairs. Separately modeled engine field updates bypass Lua setter hooks and recover through native layout/world events. Combat/deferred cleanup/latest-intent/Hide/Details behavior is tested. No game input, profiling or foreground control.
metricsScope: 500burstTimers=2 is one wake in each of two plain/gamepad fixtures, not two wakes per burst. Frames=4 counts existing addon-created fixture frames; it excludes native widgets/skin/threat module resources. addonSnapWrites counts modeled calls into native snap metadata callbacks from addon geometry; it is not an engine taint measurement. Native snap writes belong to deliberately replayed native restoration. Source calls to type/session setters and entry walks remain unchanged during pure repairs.
nativeMeasurements: Current candidate native build/profile/addons/hardware/settings/screenshots/CPU/allocation/memory/frame-time/FPS not captured. Native protection/secret safety/pixel parity and C++cache behavior remain pending. The screenshot establishes a user-reported Map startup leak, not candidate acceptance; startup ownership has its separate public regression/comparison.
